common_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a finished main-scene background for a cozy mobile pet-camp game. Create ONE new full-bleed SQUARE illustration at exactly 1024 x 1024 pixels, opaque PNG, not a contact sheet.

Input image 1 (art/guide/style-camp.jpg) is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its softness, cheerful colors, rounded friendly design and painted illustration quality. DO NOT copy its portrait aspect ratio, composition, tree placements, tent placement or camera depth. Follow the new composition in the text below.

UNIFIED STYLE: hand-painted 2D game illustration, NOT a 3D render — the exact look of the attached style
reference (art/guide/style-camp.jpg): soft painterly cel shading with gentle gradients, rounded simplified
shapes, warm cheerful pastel colors, soft daylight from the upper left, only light ambient occlusion, clean
tidy edges, no hard black outlines. No glossy or plastic materials, no photoreal lighting, no depth of field,
no lens effects, no visible brush texture. No text, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no borders. Everything is
cute, friendly and calm.

PROMPT: A finished main scene for a cozy mobile pet-camp game, square 1:1, painted in UNIFIED STYLE exactly like
the attached style reference (same hand-painted 2D look, same softness and palette; do NOT copy its layout).
Layout inspired by the camp in Pokémon Sleep: a wide, open grassy clearing seen from above at about 45 degrees, filling most of the
image. Slightly below the center a stone campfire ring with a small fire and a big round clay cooking pot hanging
from a wooden tripod (the pot is the hero of the scene: empty, its wooden lid leaning against the stones). Far
away in the upper-left corner of the meadow a cute cozy camping tent with its door open toward the fire. Two
small empty food bowls on the grass at the lower right of the fire. A soft band of round forest trees
along the top edge, gentle hills and sky beyond. The meadow itself stays clean, flat and even with only tiny
flowers and grass texture, because the game pastes decorations onto it: no paths, no rocks, no water, no clutter
away from the campsite; a log or two and a lantern right beside the fire are welcome. Warm morning light, calm
and inviting, polished like a premium game key visual. No text, no UI, no characters.

Gameplay-critical layout:
- High 45-degree downward, almost orthographic view, tops of the pot and bowls plainly visible. Flat level continuous ground, consistent scale in all parts of the meadow. No raised islands, platforms, slopes or curved horizon lawn.
- At least 80% of the square is an OPEN clean smooth even green lawn, reaching the left, right and bottom edges. Only very sparse tiny flowers and delicate uniform painted grass texture. No paths or trails, no exposed dirt patch, no water of any kind, no scattered rocks or clutter.
- Trees are confined STRICTLY to a narrow background band at the TOP EDGE. Absolutely no freestanding trees in the lawn, along the side edges, or in the foreground.
- The tent is fully visible in the FAR UPPER-LEFT CORNER of the lawn, around x=3–25%, y=12–30%, widely separated from the cooking pot by open grass. Its open doorway faces diagonally down-right toward the campfire. Never put the tent above the pot in the middle of the picture.
- The hero clay pot is large, plump and ROUND, its opening clearly EMPTY with a dark painted interior, hanging by an iron bail from a visible wooden tripod over a SMALL fire within a ring of rounded stones. Pot belly centered around x=50%, y=58%, about 16–19% of image width. Wooden lid propped against the ring. Draw pot as matte painted earthenware with restrained broad cel shading, not glossy rendered pottery.
- Exactly TWO small EMPTY food bowls rest on the lawn immediately LOWER-RIGHT of the fire. They are separate from each other and have clearly visible empty interiors.
- Foreground and upper-middle remain empty and usable. Optional one small lantern and two short logs may sit right beside the fire.
- Everything remains crisply illustrated in the same 2D painted visual language at every distance, no bokeh or blurred forest, no photographic or raytraced lighting, no CGI toy-diorama look, no plastic shine or strong specular highlights. No characters or animals. No grids, captions, inset images, borders or UI.

Mood: peaceful, warm and inviting, a place you want to live. One cohesive finished game illustration. Native square output size exactly 1024x1024.
export: User explicitly approved proportional 1024x1024 export while preserving native originals. Native PNGs copied byte-for-byte to candidates/native, exports use Pillow LANCZOS; no crop.

validation.cli: python scripts/art/check_art.py <candidate> run separately for every final candidate; python3 resolves to an inactive WindowsApps alias, so real Python 3.12 was used.
validation.manifest_limitation: Candidate paths are absent from art/manifest.json and therefore the script CLI skips its painting checker for them.
validation.actual: Also directly call check_art.py check_painting with aspect=1.0 and minWidth=1024; independently assert PNG format and exact dimensions 1024x1024, assert native source copy SHA-256 matches.
validation.visual_review: Open flat meadow occupies the majority of frame; no water or paths; no trees in lawn, forest confined to top edge; tent upper-left facing fire; empty hanging clay pot central slightly below middle; two empty bowls lower-right. Repainted reflective material patches toward softer matte 2D cel shading.
